run_proxy_cost_tracking: run the proxy cost tracking callback to log successful LLM call costs to the database
test_cost_callback_filtering: test whether cost callback tracking is enabled based on user_api_key, user_id, team_id, and end_user_id
review_failure_hook_logging: review the async post-call failure hook that logs LLM request errors and failures to the database
build_failure_metadata_enrichment: build failure metadata by enriching with key object and team alias information from cache or database
check_error_tracking_enabled: check whether error tracking in the database is enabled via general_settings disable_error_logs flag
